description: Handwritten Japanese message signed 'Denky' that reads: 'After a long time, teaming up with Back Cyc's Ueda Metafa really got me pumped!!! 久しぶりのBack Cyc.上田メタフさんとのタッグ、超テンション上がりました！！！あまりにも気合が入りすぎて曲のBtも長くなってしまいましたが、今までのデンカレ×かけるBlack Cycの全てをつぎ込んだので余すことなく聴いて下さいね！！

It's been a while since a Back Cyc. collab — teaming up with Ueda Metaf again got me absolutely hyped!!! I got so into it that the song's BPM ended up going long, but I poured everything from all the Denkare × Kakeru × Black Cyc work into this, so please listen to every last bit of it!!
Denky
